app.name: Car Checker
app.tagline: The maintenance logbook of your vehicles

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.notFound: This page does not exist or you no longer have access to it.
errors.forbidden: Your role on this vehicle does not allow this action.

codes.EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED: An account already uses this email. Sign in instead.
codes.INVALID_TOKEN: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
codes.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
codes.FORBIDDEN: Your role on this vehicle does not allow this action.
codes.MILEAGE_DECREASE: This reading is lower than a previous one. Check it, or confirm the odometer was replaced.
codes.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large (10 MB maximum).
codes.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: Use a PDF, JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC file.

auth.hero: Every service, every kilometre, on record.
auth.heroBody: Know what is due before it costs you, and keep the full history of your cars in one place.
auth.signInBody: Welcome back. Your logbook is waiting.
auth.registerBody: It takes a minute. You can delete your account and its data at any time.
auth.passwordRule: At least 8 characters, with letters and digits.
auth.forgotBody: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.checkInboxBody: If an account uses {{email}}, a link to reset the password is on its way. It is valid for 30 minutes.
auth.resetBody: All your devices will be signed out.
auth.resetLinkInvalid: This reset link is incomplete. Request a new one.
auth.passwordReset: Password changed. Sign in with the new one.

validation.decimal_one: Enter a number with at most {{count}} decimal, e.g. 12.5.
validation.decimal_other: Enter a number with at most {{count}} decimals, e.g. 120.50.
